title: Text structure Practice 1
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused text structure questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Cool Roof Pilot

Several apartment roofs absorbed intense afternoon heat. Owners coated three roofs with a reflective surface and left three unchanged. Indoor temperatures were then compared during similar weather.

TEXT B - Mangrove Roots

Mangrove roots slow moving water and trap sediment. As sediment collects, shorelines can become more stable, and sheltered areas may provide habitat for young fish.

TEXT C - Two Reminder Systems

Text reminders are inexpensive and reach phones quickly. Voice calls can take more staff time but may work better for clients who rarely read texts. A clinic compares both before choosing a mixed system.

TEXT D - Archive Scan

First, staff remove staples from fragile documents. Next, each page is scanned. After files are checked, the originals return to protective folders and digital copies are added to the catalog.
